links.comparator_used: Baseline prompt (first answer, no self-verification step)
links.outcome: NIHSS subscore exact-match accuracy, subscore MAE, total score MAE and total exact accuracy
links.effect: Small models: subscore accuracy 65.0 ± 10.9% vs 53.2 ± 10.0% at baseline; subscore MAE 0.55 ± 0.21 vs 0.84 ± 0.22; total MAE 4.84 ± 2.30 vs 7.19 ± 3.54 (all p < 0.001); total exact accuracy stayed modest at 9.6 ± 15.7%. Frontier models: no significant group-level change.
links.quote: CoVe prompting substantially improves NIHSS extraction in small LLMs while producing negligible effects in frontier models.
